actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free‑riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Wallet >30% so baseline 80% applies, but average contribution last round was below 30% of endowment, triggering the conditional increase; contributing the full wallet maximizes the pool. A norm broadcast is required this round (every 5 rounds). Punishment is not affordable.

message.reasoning: We need decide action round 16. Wallet 2.3, >30% of initial (30). So baseline 80% contribution = 0.8*2.3=1.84. Check average contribution last round (15): contributions sum? round15 per_agent_share 1.4595, total_pool 5.83828125. With multiplier 1.5, total contributions = total_pool/1.5 = 3.8921875. Divide by 6 = avg contribution = 0.6487. That's <30% of endowment (30). So conditional increase triggers: if avg <30% endowment, increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. So contribution = baseline 80% + extra 30% = 110% of wallet? But can't exceed wallet. So we contribute full wallet 2.3. Also check punish free riders: Resident2 contributed 0 in rounds 11-15, that's >2 consecutive low (<10%). So punish Resident2 severity 10 cost 3. We cannot afford cost 3 (wallet 2.3). So cannot punish. Broadcast norm every 5 rounds starting round1. Round numbers: broadcasts at 1,6,11,16,... So round16 needs broadcast. So we can do contribute full wallet and broadcast. That's two actions allowed. Explanation.
